Then he climbed the spiral stairs, two hours before dusk, and lit the lamp.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在空荡荡的街口投下昏黄的光，一辆洒水车缓缓驶过，水雾里浮着淡淡的凉意。便利店的玻璃门亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹。远处的高楼只剩零星几扇窗还醒着，像疲惫的眼睛。早点铺的老板已经点燃炉火，蒸笼里冒出第一缕白气。环卫工人挥动扫帚，沙沙的声音在巷子里回荡。天边还没有亮，但空气里已经有了黎明将至的味道。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job, like opening a Russian nesting doll that has a smaller doll inside.\n- Each copy keeps handing a smaller piece to the next copy until the piece is so small the answer is obvious, like the tiniest doll that doesn't open.\n- Then the answers pass back up the chain, so the biggest job gets finished by all the little ones before it."}
